---
title: "Writings"
description-meta: "Long-form articles on artificial intelligence, machine learning, and doctoral research in data science and medicine."
lang: es
listing:
  contents:
    - posts
    - Articles
  type: table
  sort: "date desc"
  sort-ui: false
  filter-ui: false
  categories: false
  feed: true
  fields: [image, date, title, reading-time-display]
  field-display-names:
    image: " "
    reading-time-display: "Tiempo de lectura"
  date-format: long
page-layout: full
toc: false
---

<style>
/* Tabla editorial del listing — todo scopeado a #listing-listing
   (id exclusivo de esta página); no afecta Home/About/CV/navbar. */
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table {
  width: 100%;
  table-layout: fixed;
  border-collapse: collapse;
  background: transparent;
  box-shadow: none;
}

#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table th,
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td {
  border: none;
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lf-line, #E2E8F0);
  padding: 0.85rem 0.75rem;
  vertical-align: middle;
  background: transparent;
}

#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table thead th {
  border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lf-line, #E2E8F0);
  font-size: 1rem;
  font-weight: 600;
  letter-spacing: 0.08em;
  text-transform: uppercase;
  color: var(--lf-muted, #6B7280);
  padding-top: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 991.98px) {
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table thead th {
    font-size: 0.9rem;
  }
}

/* Column proportions: thumbnail | date | title | reading time */
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(1),
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(1) { width: 7%; padding-right: 0; }
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(2),
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(2) { width: 18%; }
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(3),
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(3) { width: 57%; }
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table th:nth-child(4),
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(4) { width: 18%; }

/* Date and reading time: quiet, secondary */
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(2),
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(4) {
  color: var(--lf-muted, #6B7280);
  font-size: 0.9rem;
}

/* Title: the dominant element, using the site's existing link color */
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(3) {
  font-family: var(--lf-serif, Georgia, serif);
  font-size: 1.08rem;
}
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(3) a {
  color: var(--lf-blue, #1D4E89);
  text-decoration: none;
}
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(3) a:hover,
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(3) a:focus-visible {
  color: var(--lf-navy, #0B1E3D);
  text-decoration: underline;
}

/* Thumbnail: small and secondary — never a cover photo.
   Quarto's table listing sets an inline height (e.g. style="height:40px")
   on the <img> itself; !important is the only way to override an inline
   style, so it's used narrowly here on the two properties it sets. */
#listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(1) .listing-image img {
  height: 64px !important;
  width: auto !important;
  max-width: 100%;
  object-fit: contain;
  display: block;
}

/* Tighten the gap between the intro copy and the table */
#listing-listing {
  margin-top: 0;
}

@media (max-width: 767.98px) {
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table,
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table tbody {
    display: block;
    width: 100%;
  }
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table thead {
    display: none;
  }
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table tr {
    display: flex;
    flex-wrap: wrap;
    align-items: center;
    column-gap: 0.85rem;
    row-gap: 0.2rem;
    padding: 0.85rem 0;
    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--lf-line, #E2E8F0);
  }
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td {
    display: block;
    border: none;
    padding: 0;
    width: auto;
  }
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(1) { order: 1; flex: 0 0 auto; }
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(2) { order: 2; flex: 0 1 auto; font-size: 0.85rem; }
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(3) { order: 3; flex: 1 1 100%; font-size: 1.05rem; }
  #listing-listing table.quarto-listing-table td:nth-child(4) { order: 4; flex: 1 1 100%; font-size: 0.85rem; }
}
</style>

::: {.lf-articles-intro}
Long-form articles on artificial intelligence, machine learning, doctoral research, data science, and medicine — published here as each piece is completed.
:::
